english: DigiFusion uses DigiScores to fuse Digimon and create a different Digimon. Only the specific Digimon listed on a DigiScore can take part! They also have to meet other requirements, such as level and strength. Some DigiScores have an ▲ or ▼ mark. ▲ means the DigiScore came from the Blue version, and ▼ means it came from the Red version. Collect DigiScores to create all kinds of Digimon!

english: When a Digimon reaches its maximum level and can't grow stronger, use Jogress Up to fuse it with another Digimon. The resulting Digimon's maximum level and stats are based on the highest-level participant. It returns to Level 1 after fusion, but can grow stronger than before. Be careful: fusing Digimon of similar strength can lower some stats. One last thing: only Digimon at Level 15 or higher can take part!
